definitions.rationale: This is the macro expansion that defines the named sortEvenLoopBody AST term; it introduces no independent fact and does not summarize an already executing configuration.
definitions.text:
rule sortEvenLoopBody
    => Assign(
         Subscript(Name("result"), BinOp("*", Int(2), Name("i"))),
         Subscript(Name("evens"), Name("i")))

definitions.rationale: This is the macro expansion defining the complete named sortEvenBody AST term used by the claims and closure binding.
definitions.text:
rule sortEvenBody
    => Assign(Name("result"), Call(Name("list"), Name("l")))
       Assign(
         Name("evens"),
         Call(
           Name("sorted"),
           Subscript(Name("l"), Slice(NoBound, NoBound, Int(2)))))
       Assign(Name("i"), Int(0))
       For(
         Name("i"),
         Call(
           Name("range"),
           BinOp(
             "//",
             BinOp("+", Call(Name("len"), Name("l")), Int(1)),
             Int(2))),
         sortEvenLoopBody)
       Return(Name("result"))

definitions.rationale: This unconditional equation defines evenCount as the MPY integer expression for (N + 1) // 2.
This is the guarded base equation of the fillEven recurrence, returning the current sequence when the write index has reached or passed STOP.
definitions.text:
rule fillEven(VS, _SORTED, I, STOP) => VS
    requires I >=Int STOP

definitions.rationale: This is the guarded recursive equation of fillEven, defining one even-index update and structurally advancing I toward STOP.
definitions.text:
rule fillEven(VS, SORTED, I, STOP)
    => fillEven(
         setVSAt(VS, 2 *Int I, valSeqAt(SORTED, I)),
         SORTED,
         I +Int 1,
         STOP)
    requires I <Int STOP

definitions.rationale: This equation defines sortEvenResult by composing the even-index slice, sortVS result, evenCount, and fillEven summary.
definitions.text:
rule sortEvenResult(VS)
    => fillEven(
         VS,
         sortVS(buildVS(VS, 0, vsLen(VS), 2)),
         0,
         evenCount(vsLen(VS)))
